name: Integration Testing Checklist
description: This module is a pre-completion checklist for integration testing work: a short set of checks to run before calling a integration testing task done.
content:
This module is a pre-completion checklist for integration testing work: a short set of checks to run before calling a integration testing task done.

CORE GUIDELINES
1. Keep integration testing changes scoped to what was asked; avoid unrelated cleanup in the same pass.
2. State assumptions about integration testing explicitly before proceeding, rather than leaving them implicit.
3. Re-check edge cases relevant to integration testing (empty input, boundary values, concurrent access) before calling the task done.
4. Measure before optimizing any integration testing bottleneck; do not guess at what is slow.
5. Prefer the simplest integration testing approach that satisfies the requirement over a more general one that isn't needed yet.
6. Prefer explicit, readable integration testing solutions over clever ones that are hard to verify.
7. When multiple integration testing strategies are viable, name the trade-off explicitly rather than silently picking one.
8. Check that integration testing terminology is used consistently throughout, matching existing conventions in the surrounding context.

COMMON PITFALLS TO AVOID
- Avoid mixing unrelated integration testing concerns into a single change; keep each change focused.
- Avoid introducing new integration testing abstractions before there is a second concrete use case that needs them.
- Do not skip documenting integration testing assumptions just because they seem obvious in the moment.
- Do not apply generic integration testing advice without checking it fits the specific context at hand.

CLOSING NOTE
When in doubt, prefer clarity and explicit reasoning about integration testing over a shortcut that saves a few lines but hides intent.
